cases.explain: «Многие народы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Many nations will go and say, “Come! Let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For the law will go out of Zion, and Yahweh’s word from Jerusalem;

cases.explain: «виноградной лозой» — after the preposition «под», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: But they will sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and no one will make them afraid: For the mouth of Yahweh of Armies has spoken.

cases.explain: «Господних мыслей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.
